name: hackHER Network (Bugcrowd)
notes: Affinity: women; org: Bugcrowd; join: request-form (eligibility form, then a Discord invite is emailed). Women-only hacking/bug-bounty community run by Bugcrowd.

name: Out in Tech
notes: Affinity: lgbtq; org: Out in Tech; join: free-signup (signup flow leads to their Discord, 37,000+ members, migrated 2026); scope: tech-with-security-channel. Broad queer-in-tech career community with chapters in 32+ cities.

name: TechVets
notes: Affinity: veterans; org: TechVets (Forces Employment Charity, UK); join: free-signup via the community page (Discord behind it). UK veterans, service leavers, reservists and military spouses into IT and cyber careers; 12 local UK chapters.
